verdict: An MECM client prerequisite failed during ccmsetup. Common culprits: .NET Framework version gap, Windows Installer, or Microsoft Policy Platform.
fix: Read the failure line in `ccmsetup.log` for the specific prerequisite name and required version. Install it manually on the client (or push via a one-off package), then run `ccmsetup.exe /forceinstall` to redo the install. For .NET prerequisites, verify OS-bundled version meets the MECM minimum documented in the client-prerequisites reference.
